# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Slow Scotland is free. Sign up on any page with an email address: subscribers get one email a week for twelve weeks, each with a photograph, a short story and practical notes for visiting (getting there, how long, what to bring, and food, places to stay and photo spots nearby). Two of the stories are published on the website; the others arrive only by email.
